brief.recommendation: Root blocker ads_attribution_backfill (REPORTING, may_interrupt) has expected remaining runtime ~21,596s. Waiting would cost ~$6.6M in lost checkout revenue, far exceeding the 60s degradation tolerance. Terminating costs a 360-minute replay. No protected settlements, no active change-calendar window, registry data quality passes. Trade-off decisively favors termination.

audit.report: The ads_attribution_backfill batch job (pid 1481582) held an orders lock while idle in transaction for 4.2 seconds, blocking 12 sessions and degrading checkout to 53–73% success against a 95% SLO with ~$4,907/min revenue at risk. Both guardians agreed in one round to terminate the REPORTING-class, replayable workload (360-minute replay cost) because its expected 21,596-second remaining runtime would cost ~$6.6M in lost checkout revenue, far exceeding the 60-second degradation tolerance. However, the independent authority denied the termination because the action failed app_allowlist, workload_class, and live_identity checks. The business remained degraded for the full 149.4-second negotiation with no recovery action executed, and checkout success dropped to 0% (120/120 failed) during the incident window.
audit.root_cause: The ads_attribution_backfill job acquired and held an orders lock while idle in transaction, blocking checkout sessions and causing sustained SLO violation.
lessons: For ads_attribution_backfill: Add this workload to the app_allowlist and verify its live_identity registration so emergency terminations can proceed without authority denial.
For ads_attribution_backfill: Implement an idle-in-transaction timeout on the batch_worker role to auto-terminate stuck transactions before they block checkout.
For ads_attribution_backfill: Pre-register the workload's REPORTING class and may_interrupt policy with the authority to satisfy workload_class checks during incidents.
audit.negotiation_critique: Both guardians correctly identified the blocker, quantified the trade-off ($6.6M revenue loss vs 360-minute replay), and reached agreement in one round, but neither verified authority preconditions (allowlist, class registration, live identity) before proposing termination.
follow_ups: Register ads_attribution_backfill in the app_allowlist and verify its live_identity configuration with the platform team.
Add idle-in-transaction timeout to batch_worker role to auto-terminate stuck transactions.
Document the authority's workload_class requirements for REPORTING-class may_interrupt workloads.
